current.scope: Native input on existing qualified production assets. Selected functional workflows, not complete Playwright parity, hydration interception, no-JS, full AX/computed descriptions, all history variants, speech/IME or physical-device qualification.

scope: Actual Firefox156.0.1/157.0:22 native workflow cases per release, including original scoped axe scans at eight states per release, authored/implicit status roles and native visibility, portrait/landscape RTL editing. Existing qualified production assets reused.
remaining: Native full accessibility trees and computed descriptions, speech/IME
Original navigation/history/legacy-query normalization assertions and remaining exact Playwright assertion parity
reuse: Shared Firefox transport, consumer runner and first-paint runner unchanged by hash: previous120-consumer/10-first-paint qualification retained, not rerun.

incompleteReview.aria: Additional checks verify native button popup/expanded state, menu opening/Escape focus return and same-root visible listbox ID targets. Browser-computed button/menu/listbox names are checked. This does not dismiss the host warning as a full AX/speech pass.
incompleteReview.contrast: Axe reports background overlap/partially obscured content, including slotted button labels and scrolled/clipped selection text. Retain full incomplete nodes for human/visual contrast review; no inferred contrast pass.
